title: Artificial Intelligence in Medicine and Radiation Oncology
summary: A review of potential applications of artificial intelligence in radiation oncology, particularly workflow efficiency and error reduction. It discusses automated data transfer and decision support as ways to improve clinical operations.
scope: This is a literature review of potential applications, rather than a clinical trial of a specific AI system.

title: Concept for a Fan-beam Computed Tomography Image-guided Radiotherapy Device
summary: A proposed radiotherapy device combines a 6 MV linear accelerator with fan-beam CT guidance. The paper describes the Simple XRT concept and considers equipment cost and shielding requirements in the design of a treatment system.
scope: The article presents a device concept. This summary does not establish current commercial availability, regulatory approval or clinical effectiveness.

title: Personality and Genetics Correlations to Risk-Taking Using Quantum Decision Theory in Balloon Analogue Risk Tasks
summary: A review connecting quantum decision theory with research on risk-taking in the Balloon Analogue Risk Task. It considers reported personality and genetic associations, and proposes ways to incorporate these factors into probabilistic decision models.
scope: The article reviews existing work and proposes models; these proposals should be distinguished from independently validated predictions for individuals.

title: Thermal Infrared Face Recognition
summary: A review of thermal infrared approaches to face recognition, including temperature patterns, facial vasculature and computational methods. It surveys earlier work on imaging characteristics and the use of machine learning in this field.
scope: This is a review of published methods, rather than a release of a new facial recognition product or dataset.
